## Where can agents be used in infectious disease modelling?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- At every step of the workflow, with people deciding and checking
- Reading data. Implementing, optimising and reviewing model code
- Building the infrastructure. Model checks, and refits on every push
- Talking through model development. A rubber duck that answers back
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](figures/agents-workflow-agents.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="The six-step workflow, question, data, model, fit, check and
report, with a tag over each. People over question; agents read and
digitise over data; people choose, agents write over model; agents,
every push over fit; agents run, people judge over check; agents draft,
people sign over report."}

::: {.attribution}
After Abbott et al.,
[A workflow for infectious disease modelling][wf]
:::
:::
::::

## Reading the situation reports

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- The DRC situation reports are French PDFs. Agents read every stream
  from them, and recent reports get two blind reads
- Symptom onsets are published only as a figure. An agent-written
  digitiser recovers the counts
- Cross-checked by other agents, and by digitisers written in Python and
  Julia
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](figures/agents-bvd-sitrep087-page3.png){width="92%"
fig-align="center"
fig-alt="Page 3 of INSP situation report 87, in French. A table of alerts
by province, a bar chart of confirmed cases by date of symptom onset,
and a map of cases by health zone."}

::: {.attribution}
INSP SitRep 087, 9 August 2026,
[insp.cd](https://insp.cd/ebola-17eme-epidemie/) ·
[BVDOutbreakSize][bvd-repo]
:::
:::
::::

## Implementing, optimising and reviewing

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="40%"}
- **Implementation.** Agents write the tasks from a spec or a
  conversation, then the code
- **Optimisation.** Custom gradient rules for the renewal and
  convolution kernels
- **Theory.** An integral we needed solved analytically
- **Review.** Several review agents before we read it. Our time goes on
  review and judgement
:::
::: {.column width="60%"}
![](figures/agents-agent-2.png){width="100%"
fig-alt="The agent loop fed by a box where agents write the tasks from a
spec or a conversation, with review agents sending findings back into
the loop, a person reading all the code or only the outcome, and a merge
that refits in CI and sends new tasks back to the top."}
